I would give each player a different deck, but make them both part of the same hero. For example, give one player The Dude Who Controls a Projection, a non-target hero who plays cards that produce small projections, support the team and most importantly boost Big Projection, controlled by player #2, who can be whatever you want him to be, really. Incapping BP would incap them both, and they would of course count as two heroes for the purposes of H.

Hmm... I quite like this idea, but I don't see it as something we're going to get from GTG. Too odd.
